$comment: What's new after an update. Add an entry for every version you release, newest first. The app shows the entry for its own version once, on the first launch after updating; the GitHub release notes are generated from it. A test fails if the version in package.json has no entry. Tags: new, better, fixed. Optional "welcome": ["language" | "appearance" | "reading" | "library" | "timer"] shows those welcome steps again after updating, when a change needs the user to choose something.

items.title: LumiPDF 2.0
items.text: LuminaPDF, rewritten from scratch and renamed: lighter, faster and sharper.

items.title: A library on the home screen
items.text: Pick up where you left off, add your folders, iCloud Drive and GoodNotes backups, and search by title.

items.title: Crisp dark mode
items.text: Pages are recoloured while they are drawn, so text stays as sharp as the original in all five reading themes.

items.title: Mark up as you study
items.text: Highlight, underline or strike text, write with a smooth pen, use the highlighter and sticky notes you can drag anywhere. Snip any area to copy it or save it as a PNG. Everything is listed in the Notes tab.

items.title: Export and compress
items.text: Save a copy with your annotations built in, and make big PDFs smaller: a 50 MB scanned notebook becomes 9 MB at Recommended. Password-protected PDFs keep their protection, or you can unlock the copy for good if you have the password. The original is never changed.

items.title: Formula sheets
items.text: Snip a formula or figure and add it to a sheet for the exam. Snips line up in columns on their own, or place them freely; add titles, choose A4 or Letter, and export a PDF ready to print. Click a snip to jump back to its page.

items.title: Link previews
items.text: Hover a link to an equation, figure or footnote to see it right there, in your reading theme, without losing your place.

items.title: Study timer and stats
items.text: Timer, Pomodoro, alarm and stopwatch. See today against your daily goal, your streak, the last 7 or 30 days, and what you studied most.

items.title: PDFs that wouldn't open
items.text: Protected and damaged PDFs that 1.x refused now open normally.
